links.comparator_used: Original, unsimplified prostate cancer pathology reports (paired t-tests against both GPT-4-turbo simplified versions)
links.outcome: Text complexity/readability measured with TextEvaluator across eight text-complexity dimensions
links.effect: Overall text complexity significantly reduced (p < 0.001); below-6th-grade versions improved most: academic vocabulary mean 68.47 to 23.16, syntactic complexity p = 0.0018, concrete language 36.65 to 44.12
links.quote: GPT-4 significantly reduced the overall text complexity of the pathology reports (p < 0.001).
